Calls that draw nothing (get with bound <= 0, get(origin, bound) with origin >= bound) are not recorded. Replay the returned values in order and check method and bound. intermediate.chance_estimate is the generator's own copy of the integer chance for choosing boundary draws; the real result is the Java one.
